description: This file defines an abstract base class for analyzing the end of a user's turn in audio conversations, including state enumeration, parameters, and core analysis methods.

classes.name: EndOfTurnState
classes.description: Enumeration representing whether a user has completed their turn or is still speaking.

classes.name: BaseTurnParams
classes.description: Base class for turn analyzer parameters, currently empty.

classes.name: BaseTurnAnalyzer
classes.description: Abstract base class for analyzing user end of turn in audio conversations, providing interface methods and properties.

methods.name: set_sample_rate
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for audio processing, using initial sample rate if provided.

methods.name: speech_triggered
methods.description: Abstract property to determine if speech has been detected.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Abstract property to get current turn analyzer parameters.

methods.name: append_audio
methods.description: Abstract method to append audio data for analysis and determine end-of-turn state.

methods.name: analyze_end_of_turn
methods.description: Asynchronous method to analyze if an end of turn has occurred.

methods.name: update_vad_start_secs
methods.description: Method to update voice activity detection start seconds.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Abstract method to reset the turn analyzer.
